name: Next Open – Location Booking
author: Dmitry

sections.description:
Next Open is a complete appointment booking solution for businesses with multiple locations. Simple to set up, powerful to use.

Core Features

  • Multiple location management with individual schedules
  • Real-time availability checking
  • Automated email confirmations for customers and admins
  • Customizable time slots (15, 30, or 60 minutes)
  • Business hours and holiday scheduling
  • Mobile-responsive booking interface
  • Customer database management
  • Dashboard with appointment overview

Perfect For

  • Medical and dental offices
  • Hair salons and barbershops
  • Consulting services
  • Service-based businesses
  • Any business that takes appointments

Pro Features Available

Upgrade to Next Open Pro for advanced capabilities:

  • Staff management with photos and schedules
  • Services with variable pricing
  • Custom form fields
  • Customer self-service portal (cancel/reschedule)
  • Stripe payment processing
  • CSV import/export
  • Buffer times between appointments

Learn more about Pro

Support

For support inquiries, contact Admin@oiopublisher.com

Documentation: https://oiopublisher.com/docs
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/next-open-location-booking/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Next Open > Locations to add your first location
  4. Configure business hours and time slots
  5. Add the booking form to any page: [next_open_booking]
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes. The free version includes unlimited locations, appointments, and email notifications.

Can I accept payments?

Payment processing requires Next Open Pro, which includes Stripe integration.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. Next Open works with any properly coded WordPress theme.

How do I get support?

For support, email Admin@oiopublisher.com

Can customers cancel or reschedule?

The customer portal (available in Pro) allows customers to manage their own appointments 24/7.
